findings.description: This inline policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", letting a single deploy user read and modify all S3 data, terminate instances, and alter Lambda code across the account — a broad privilege-escalation and data-exposure surface well beyond deployment needs.

A static IAM access key is created for the svc_deploy user; it does not rotate and, paired with the wildcard policy above, constitutes a highly privileged long-lived credential that is not tied to a role or short-lived federation.

The access key secret is exported as a Terraform output from encrypted_secret, so the credential is persisted in state and displayed in CLI output/CI logs, disclosing it to anyone with access to state or logs.
